facts.fact: At the fourth session of the Algerian-Tunisian Joint Technical Commission on communications and ICT cooperation, held in Tunisia and led by Algeria's minister, the two governments agreed several joint projects on connectivity, postal and telecom modernisation and digital innovation; no event date is given, so the published date 2026-06-09 is used.
